turn.user_message: Our doctors don’t use voice notes, and we don’t record half these details today.
turn.context: Playbook §5: a factual correction, not resistance. Concede it, then show the new layer and how little it needs.

text: Fair challenge. I described your rounds as if each decision was already recorded. It isn’t, and it doesn’t need to be.
Tojo adds the recording as a new layer. Your hospital only shares what it already keeps.
chat.pointer: The maze shows the routes Tojo tried for recording each decision. Pick a route to see why it fails or works.

blocks.title: A new layer, not a new habit
blocks.deck: Four ways to record each decision on the evening round. Three hit a wall. One gets through with what you already have.

blocks.start: Record each decision on the evening round
blocks.goal: Every decision recorded, with nothing new for doctors to learn

routes.name: Voice notes on the round
routes.why: Your doctors don’t use them. Asking for them adds work to a busy round.

routes.name: Type every summary at night
routes.why: Your typists work in the morning. The queue moves to the night, but the work stays.

routes.name: Wait for new hospital software
routes.why: It takes months. The two-week trial does not need it.

routes.name: A one-tap form, plus notes you already keep
routes.why: The doctor taps once on the ward phone for each decision. Tojo drafts the rest from your files.
needs: Doctors deciding on the evening round, as they do today
Notes and reports kept in your hospital software
Your IT team lets Tojo read your records
